name: Froglet public agent task manifest
purpose: Give HTTP-capable agents exact Froglet task contracts, evidence boundaries, and report fields before they run or recommend a hosted or local Froglet workflow.

task_contracts.title: Hosted proof
task_contracts.when_to_use: Use when the user asks whether Froglet works, gives no additional context, or wants a no-install proof.
steps: GET /api/preflight
POST /api/sessions
GET /v1/provider/services
POST /v1/runtime/deals for demo.add
GET /v1/runtime/deals/{deal_id} until terminal status
Report evidence before recommendations
must_not_claim: paid Lightning, Stripe, or x402 settlement
task_contracts.next_step: If the hosted proof succeeds, ask for user context before recommending local install or a workflow-specific experiment.

task_contracts.title: Hosted proof with witness
task_contracts.when_to_use: Use when the user wants stronger evidence and provides a URL, expected hash, file hash, or content hash they own or control.
required_capabilities: ability to choose exactly one follow-up service
allowed_hosts: user-owned witness URL only when explicitly authorized
steps: Run hosted-proof first
Choose demo.fetch-witness for an owned URL
Choose demo.hash-verify for an owned URL plus expected SHA-256
Choose demo.notarize for a caller-supplied content hash
Report demo.add evidence before follow-up evidence
must_not_claim: durable notarization beyond the signed hosted receipt
hash correctness unless the observed hash equals the expected hash
task_contracts.next_step: Use the follow-up result to pick a local evidence workflow only after reporting what the hosted proof still did not prove.

task_contracts.title: Receipt feed check
task_contracts.when_to_use: Use after a successful hosted deal when the user asks for receipt/feed proof or marketplace-style evidence.
required_capabilities: compare signed deal_hash or quote_hash fields
steps: GET /v1/feed
Treat the response as a Froglet artifact envelope
Inspect signed artifacts such as descriptors, offers, and receipts
Match receipt artifacts by deal_hash or quote_hash, not runtime deal_id
task_contracts.next_step: Use /verify-receipt/ for structural inspection if the user pastes a receipt artifact, while stating that browser inspection is not cryptographic signature verification.

task_contracts.title: Receipt artifact structural verification
task_contracts.when_to_use: Use when the user pastes a receipt or artifact envelope and wants to understand whether it has the expected Froglet receipt fields.
steps: Paste the receipt JSON or feed artifact envelope
Run structural inspection
Report receipt-like fields, signature presence, hash presence, deal_hash, and quote_hash
State what remains unverified
task_contracts.next_step: For cryptographic verification, use the kernel/conformance verifier path from the repository rather than the browser helper.

task_contracts.title: Marketplace evidence snapshot
task_contracts.when_to_use: Use when the user asks what the public marketplace currently shows or wants copyable evidence from the marketplace page.
required_capabilities: fetch marketplace JSON links when needed
copy or quote observed counts with timestamps
steps: Read the rendered marketplace counts
Record snapshot time, providers, offers, receipts, success rate, and indexed receipt value
Use the page copy action or JSON endpoints for source evidence
Avoid claiming hosted paid rails from marketplace counts alone
must_not_claim: production marketplace depth beyond observed public data
task_contracts.next_step: Use local install planning if the user wants to publish a service, consume private services, or test paid rails.

task_contracts.title: Local install proposal
task_contracts.when_to_use: Use after the hosted evidence report when the user wants persistent identity, service publication, paid rails, private data workflows, batch, GPU, or Tor.
required_capabilities: use local MCP/OpenClaw planning tools when available
avoid running install commands before confirmation
allowed_hosts: local machine only after explicit user confirmation
steps: Finish the hosted evidence report first
Ask for target agent, footprint, role, payment rail, network mode, marketplace, and first use case
Use plan_install before get_install_guide when local MCP tools exist
Verify local health before implementing the use case
must_not_claim: local installation was performed before commands actually ran
payment rails are live before adapter verification
GPU or batch production readiness before route-specific checks
task_contracts.next_step: After the profile is confirmed, produce exact commands and validation checks for the selected local path.

task_contracts.title: Chat-only fallback
task_contracts.when_to_use: Use when the model cannot fetch URLs, POST JSON, send Bearer auth, poll HTTP routes, run shell commands, or use MCP tools.
steps: Do not pretend to run the proof
Tell the user a proper test requires an HTTP-capable agentic environment or the manual curl flow
Offer to interpret pasted outputs
task_contracts.next_step: Direct the user to an HTTP-capable agent or the manual curl flow.
